Cards.Name: Centering the Soul
Cards.Text: Reaction: After an action resolves, bow this card and target one of your Rings the action bowed: Straighten the Ring. If this Shugenja is Void, you may destroy this card; if you did, you may use the Ring's base abilities an additional time this turn.

Cards.Name: Erosion
Cards.Text:
While this Shugenja is Water, other players' provinces have -1 strength.
Reaction: After the resolution of an action that moved a Personality to the current battlefield: Give him -4F.
